tool_input.command: git stash && bun test 2>&1 | tail -40; git stash pop

result: The bug was in `app/Http/Resources/PostResource.ts`: `toArray()` built the response object without an `excerpt` field, even though `PostResourceData` declared one — the `super.toJSON() as PostResourceData` cast in `toJSON()` hid the mismatch from the type checker, so it compiled fine while silently dropping the excerpt from every response (index list, show page, and edit form all consume this resource). Search still worked because it queries the `excerpt` column directly in `PostController`, bypassing the resource entirely. I added the missing `excerpt: post.excerpt as string` line to `toArray()`; `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass.
